_comment: The site's mark, in one place: the favicon and the header wordmark drew the same path from two hand-written copies. Not an .svg because the colours differ per surface — the wordmark takes currentColor, the favicon its own plate. JSON so generate-images.mjs can read it without a TypeScript loader. NOTE: this is not the extension's toolbar icon, which is a different mark (src/assets/icons/*.png, blue X with a question mark) and is what the in-page rating ask shows.
